title: Stay Until Sunrise
caption: 1990s Eurodance, euphoric piano-house club anthem, powerful melodic female lead vocal only, bright M1 house piano chords, uplifting synth-string pads, bouncy offbeat synth bass, punchy four-on-the-floor 909 kick, crisp claps and open hi-hats, catchy sung chorus with female harmony doubles, warm polished 1994 club production, short instrumental intro and outro, no male voice, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - Instrumental]

[Verse]
I left my coat beside the door
Your footsteps found me on the floor
The last bus left an hour ago
We have nowhere else to go

[Pre-Chorus]
Let the room turn round and round
Keep me here inside this sound

[Chorus]
Stay until the morning comes
Hold me where the bass drum runs
When the daylight finds our eyes
We will carry home the sunrise
Stay until the morning comes
We can dance till night is done
Take my hand and count to four
I am ready for one more

[Instrumental - Piano]

[Chorus]
Stay until the morning comes
Hold me where the bass drum runs
When the daylight finds our eyes
We will carry home the sunrise
Stay until the morning comes
We can dance till night is done
Take my hand and count to four
I am ready for one more

[Outro - Instrumental]

title: After the Last Tram
caption: 1990s Eurodance and melodic rave, urgent minor-key nightclub anthem, expressive powerful female alto singing only, soaring female chorus harmonies, driving four-on-the-floor 909 drums, rolling synth bass, sharp rave piano stabs, bright detuned sawtooth synth hook, rhythmic arpeggiator, dramatic gated synth strings, energetic 1995 European club production, short beat-driven instrumental intro and outro, no male vocals, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - Instrumental]

[Verse]
The last tram rolled around the bend
I thought our night was at an end
But through the door I heard that beat
And turned away from empty streets

[Pre-Chorus]
Pull me closer, let it play
We can find another way

[Chorus]
One more song before we go
One more turn and take it slow
All the clocks can wait outside
We have got this little time
One more song before we go
Let me feel that rhythm grow
If the night is running out
Turn it up and drown it out

[Instrumental - Synth Hook]

[Chorus]
One more song before we go
One more turn and take it slow
All the clocks can wait outside
We have got this little time
One more song before we go
Let me feel that rhythm grow
If the night is running out
Turn it up and drown it out

[Outro - Instrumental]
